92:1: By the night when it covers.
92:2: By the day when it becomes manifest.
92:3: And by the One Who created the male and the female.
92:4: Undoubtedly, your effort is certainly diverse.
92:7: We also will grant him success toward the easiest.
92:8: And yet whoever was stingy and considered himself self-sufficient,
92:10: We also will ease him toward the hardest.
92:11: And his wealth will not benefit him when he falls.
92:13: And undoubtedly, both the Hereafter and the world are Ours.
92:14: I have warned you of a flaming fire.
92:15: None leans upon it except the most wretched,
92:16: He who denied and turned away.
92:17: The one who guards most, however, will be kept away from it,
92:18: The one who gives his wealth, purifying himself,
92:19: And he is not indebted to anyone for a blessing to be recompensed,
92:20: Only desiring the face of his exalted Rabb.
92:21: And he will surely be pleased.
